notes: Adding an agent: copy prompts/agents/_template/ to prompts/agents/<key>/, fill persona.md, questions.md and cv.md, then add one entry above (order controls display and Round 1 column position; grid=true puts the agent in the 3/4/5-column layout; in_round1=true means it speaks independently in the parallel Round 1). colour/colour_soft drive the chip, column header, message rule and both exports. No code change needed beyond reading this file. Agents are country-agnostic: {{COUNTRY}} comes from the session's own inputs, and every country-specific fact is identified by the agent's own search each turn, not baked into these files.
